title: Lord, I’m Coming Home
alsoKnownAs: I’ve Wandered Far Away from God
description: Lord, I’m Coming Home in Tonic Solfa to COMING HOME: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the six verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: William J. Kirkpatrick wrote the words and the tune COMING HOME at a camp meeting in Rawlinsville, Pennsylvania; the song was published in Winning Songs (Philadelphia, 1892).
underlay: I’ve wan-dered far a-way_ from God, Now I’m com-ing home; The paths of sin too long_ I’ve trod, Lord, I’m com-ing home. Com-ing home, com-ing home, Nev-er-more to roam; O-pen wide Thine arms_ of love, Lord, I’m com-ing home.

lines: I’ve wandered far away from God,
The paths of sin too long I’ve trod,

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Open wide Thine arms of love,
I now repent with bitter tears,
I’m tired of sin and straying, Lord,
I’ll trust Thy love, believe Thy word,
My soul is sick, my heart is sore,
My strength renew, my hope restore,
My only hope, my only plea,
That Jesus died, and died for me,
I need His cleansing blood I know,
Oh, wash me whiter than the snow,
